Late fee
None so far. If this invoice is not fully paid 14 days after the due date, EGP 100 is added.
See fee policies
Fee Policies
Example policy for the demo. Each school sets its own terms.
Late fees
There is a 14-day grace period after the due date. After that, EGP 100 per month is added, up to EGP 300 per invoice. You can ask the school to waive a late fee from Requests.
Sibling discount
Families with two or more children enrolled get EGP 500 off each term of school fees. It is applied automatically on the invoice.
Installments
Term fees can be paid in up to 3 installments at no extra cost. Pay each one by card, wallet or bank transfer.
Refunds
Trip and activity payments are refundable until 7 days before the date. Tuition is not refundable once the term starts. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 to 14 working days.
